scientific_integrity: Fixed-space theorem derived from explicit topological semantics and a constructive normal-form proof; computational examples corroborate rather than replace that proof.
scientific_limitations: Unrestricted valuations on the one-point compactification of a countable discrete set; no statement about higher-rank spaces, additional modalities, or independently established historical priority.
title: Depth-one collapse and exact finite-variable algebra for accumulation logic on a convergent sequence
